title: Canonical pro-etale constant coefficient maps respect composition
statement:
Let $h:Z\to Y$ and $k:Y\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. For $T=X,Y,Z$ use the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $c_f:f^{-1}A_{\mathrm{target}(f)}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{\mathrm{source}(f)}$ be the canonical map preserving constant sections of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], and let $\alpha_{h,k}:(k\circ h)^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}h^{-1}k^{-1}$ be the inverse-image composition isomorphism compatible with the inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Then
$$c_{k\circ h}=c_h\circ h^{-1}(c_k)\circ\alpha_{h,k,A_X}:(k\circ h)^{-1}A_X\longrightarrow A_Z.$$
This is an equality of ring-sheaf maps, including when $Z$ is empty.

proof.text: Use the published inverse-image and constant coefficient definitions [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The sheafification Hom equivalence [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives the component equation toSheafify(Y).app(B) followed by rho_f.app(B) equals toSheafify(X).app(f^*B). This is private helper rho_unit; it uses the defining extension of the constant presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], not invertibility of c_f.

proof.text: Let beta:R_k R_h -> R_(hk) be sheafPushforwardContinuousComp′ for the published fibre-product comparison [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. In private helper rho_comp apply injectivity of the sheafification Hom equivalence [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and then presheaf extensionality. The equation of Step 1 twice reduces the desired rho_k followed by R_k(rho_h) followed by beta equals rho_(hk) to naturality of the constant-presheaf sheafification unit along pullbackComp.hom. The constant presheaf restriction is the identity. This argument includes empty objects without distinguishing their constants.

proof.text: For adjunctions a:L left adjoint to R and b:L′ left adjoint to R′, and beta:R′ isomorphic to R, private helper homEquiv_mate proves a.homEquiv(alpha_X followed by t) = b.homEquiv(t) followed by beta_Y, where alpha is the inverse of (conjugateIsoEquiv a b).symm beta.symm. Expand both Hom equivalences as unit followed by right-adjoint image. The unit equation [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] and naturality of beta give the result. For the site adjunctions this alpha is definitionally the published supportSiteProEtaleComparisonComp [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback].

proof.text: Apply injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence for h followed by k. The left side has adjunct rho_(hk) by the coefficient-map definition [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Apply Step 3 to the right side. Expand the composite Hom equivalence using Adjunction.comp_homEquiv [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]; naturality on its left and right variables and apply_symm_apply identify the two successive adjuncts with rho_k followed by R_k(rho_h). Step 2 finishes. No coefficient isomorphism theorem, finiteness, nonemptiness, or module/derived comparison is used.

The coefficient category is ring sheaves on small pro-etale sites, the base change is V -> X x_Y V, and c_f is the adjunct of rho^f, which the prop's commutative clause identifies with the definition's map. The math is correct. Step 1: phi_B is a Z-isomorphism with the right variance, giving d=G(phi_B). Step 2: both maps send a to the constant a on the constant presheaf, so uniqueness of sheafification in rings gives the equality. Step 3: the conjugate lemma with delta=d^{-1}:R_kR_h->R_kh gives alpha:L_kh->L_hL_k in the right direction, and the composite unit is R_k(eta_h L_k)eta_k. Step 4: unit naturality at c_k and the triangle identities give R_k(rho^h)rho^k. Step 5: naturality of d, cancelling d and injectivity of the adjunction bijection give the equality. Step 6: the empty case is redundant but correct. Edge cases tested: Z empty, A=0, identity h or k, and a disconnected object. proof_deps equals the union of uses, there is no cycle and no cited node is merged. lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleCoefficientInverseImageMap_comp
    {Z W V : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] :
    proEtaleCoefficientInverseImageMap (h ≫ k) A =
      (ProEtale.supportSiteProEtaleComparisonComp CommRingCat.{u + 1} h k).hom.app
          (proEtaleConstantRing V A) ≫
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
          (proEtaleCoefficientInverseImageMap k A) ≫
        proEtaleCoefficientInverseImageMap h A
lean.note: Exact existing theorem of lem-pur-proetale-constant-ring-composition. The coefficient maps are the constant-section adjuncts, identified by prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map; the comparison is the adjunction mate of canonical fibre-product associativity. CommRingCat expresses the commutative-ring-sheaf maps in this statement. No nonempty-scheme hypothesis.
